_about: HAMMOUR advisory database. Seeded with real, verified ICS CVEs and protocol-level weaknesses. Refreshable from CISA ICS Advisories (CSAF) and vendor PSIRTs. CVSS values and advisory IDs verified against official sources.

cves.title: Memory protection bypass → native code execution on the CPU
cves.fix: Update the CPU firmware to the fixed version listed in SSA-434534

cves.title: UMAS authentication bypass — unauthenticated read/write to the PLC
cves.fix: Apply Schneider firmware fix; enforce application password and segment the PLC

cves.title: Hard-coded key lets an attacker bypass auth and change PLC config/code
cves.fix: Update firmware; restrict traffic to the controller and monitor Studio 5000 sessions

cves.title: Global private key extractable — decrypt protected config and bypass protections
cves.fix: Update to TIA Portal V18 + fixed firmware; rotate the per-device key

cves.title: Crafted packets to the EN100 module crash the protection relay (DoS)
cves.fix: Update the EN100 Ethernet module firmware; segment the relay network

weaknesses.title: Modbus has no authentication — any host can read or command the device
weaknesses.fix: Cannot be patched (protocol design). Segment, allow-list sources, and monitor writes (Hunt)

weaknesses.title: S7comm (classic) has weak/no authentication — STOP and program download are unauthenticated
weaknesses.fix: Enable access protection where supported; segment and monitor program changes (Hunt)

weaknesses.title: DNP3 without Secure Authentication — control commands are unauthenticated
weaknesses.fix: Enable DNP3 Secure Authentication (SAv5); segment and monitor

weaknesses.title: EtherNet/IP (CIP) has no built-in authentication for most services
weaknesses.fix: Use CIP Security where supported; segment and monitor

weaknesses.title: OT protocol traffic is unencrypted — can be sniffed and modified in transit
weaknesses.fix: Isolate OT networks; where supported use encrypted variants; monitor for tampering
